qualification: Mechanical TOML comparison using package name, version and source as identity. Lockfiles do not encode resolved feature selections or demonstrate actual calls, builds, semantic behavior, historical adoption, source coverage, or validation. Multiple versions and sources remain distinct. Raw lockfiles are preserved or recoverable as indicated; the historical p16 and pr-working roles are never promoted into the later checkpoint.

reported_selected.qualification: latest reported selected source, not the missing final ledger or checkpoint
reported_selected.tree_association: Local Git commit/tree lookup; commit is the reported selected source, not a recovered final checkpoint.

current.tree_association: Local Git commit/tree lookup; current source revision.

next_work: Use changed and retained dependency entries as navigation for relevant native bodies and feature-boundary questions in each lens; do not infer current findings from presence or absence in a lockfile.
